ios.desc:
Speak across languages with Arda Translate on iPhone and iPad. After setup, speech recognition and translation run on your device. Your conversation audio and text are not sent to a cloud translation service.

TWO-WAY CONVERSATIONS
Choose a language for each person and hold the microphone while speaking. Live translated text appears as you speak, and the final phrase updates in place when you release. Rotate the upper pane for someone sitting opposite you.

PERSONAL LIVE TRANSLATION
Choose incoming and output languages, then tap Start to keep listening through pauses. Follow the translated text, scroll back, or jump to the latest phrase. Turn on read aloud if you prefer spoken translations; listening pauses during playback and resumes afterward. Stop listening whenever you choose.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
Type when speaking is inconvenient. Shared menus follow a supported device language, with English as the fallback. Each conversation pane keeps its instructions and privacy label in that person's selected language.

Choose from English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Dutch, Turkish, and Polish.

No account, ads, or subscription. Initial setup asks permission to download a large translation model; Wi-Fi is recommended. Speech and voice availability depend on your device and selected languages.

For everyday conversations. Do not rely on Arda Translate as your only translation source for medical, legal, emergency, or safety-critical situations.

quotes.text:
Hi C.J. here, I made a free app that does on device translation using Gemma Translate 4B AI model repackaged for iOS. This allows for after model download, private offline translation locally on your iOS device.

I made this app after trying to talk to my neighbor and service not being great at the bus stop where I drop off my daughter. I have tried to make the app UX easy to use and I really like the default view where the translations appear flipped on each side so you can hold the phone in the middle and each person has a side of the phone.

Hope you enjoy and let me know what you think!
